before.lib/requests.ex:
defmodule Requests do
  @doc "Parsed payload is a list of up to 100,000 maps; audit records only its ID."
  def accepted(payload, sink) do
    request = %{id: make_ref(), payload: payload}
    Audit.record(request, sink)
    request.id
  end
end

after.lib/audit.ex:
defmodule Audit do
  @doc "Send the request ID to the local audit sink."
  def record(request, sink) do
    id = request.id
    Task.start(fn -> send(sink, {:request, id}) end)
  end
end
